title: Expose stale and invalid Item intent links
preconditions: Use exact Item relation fixture with one story relation and one criterion relation.
Use disposable test fixtures only: public authoring can create a stale pin after a valid revision, but rejects a nonexistent target. Invalid-endpoint browser fixture support remains unproven.

steps.action: Change the stored source content pin to a nonmatching digest and make the second target missing in the test fixture; rebuild the story projection.
steps.expected_result: The first link is stale and the missing-target link is invalid.

steps.action: In a browser, inspect an Item relation made stale by a supported public revision.
steps.expected_result: The link is visibly stale and retains story/criterion and rationale context.

steps.action: With an explicitly supplied malformed or externally broken disposable reader fixture, inspect the missing-endpoint Item link; first establish that the reader supports loading this fixture.
steps.expected_result: If the broken document can be loaded, the drawer exposes invalid currency rather than hiding or presenting the link as current. Public authoring continues to reject missing endpoints.

expected_result: Stale and invalid links remain distinguishable; invalid-fixture browser feasibility is an open verification gap.
